fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League's fractious politics have always made centralized BattleMech procurement difficult, pushing the FWLM toward heavy investment in conventional infantry to fill the gaps. Tracked mechanized platoons sacrifice road speed for all-terrain capability, carrying their infantry across ground that would halt wheeled vehicles. The FWLM assigns these formations to worlds where rough terrain or poor infrastructure demands mobility that wheels cannot provide. Armed with heavy extended-range laser rifles that combine punishing energy output with extended reach, these platoons deliver devastating firepower at ranges that outstrip most personal infantry weapons.
